title: smi.phone/native/v1 — Flutter↔native bridge contract (spec section 10.2)
description: EventChannel payloads native→Dart and MethodChannel request/response shapes. One owner dispatcher only. Unknown/nullable fields must be handled defensively; no stack/SIP raw errors cross this boundary.

eventId.description: unique per event; used by Dart ackEvent exactly once (idempotent)

callId.description: server callId for incoming; attemptId for outgoing until mapping exists

pushToken.description: present only for pushTokenChanged; never logged, never broadcast

capabilities.description: platform capability map, e.g. {microphone:boolean, callstyle:boolean, voipPush:boolean}

detail.description: short human-safe reason; no raw stack traces

reportOutgoing.description: outgoing native UUID = attemptId for the whole call lifetime (spec 9.3)

getPendingEvents.description: native event queue; consumed at cold start / resume before any new dispatch

secureStore.description: op in {read,write,delete}; backed by Android Keystore AES-GCM / iOS Keychain AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly
